response.text:
Adding a phone number requires a contract change, so I'm stopping without a code change.

=== ACTION: limitation ===
{"reason": "The goal needs a contract change, which I'm not allowed to make. The output schema of customers.lookup@1 declares only customerId, name, email, tier and since. It has no phone field. Its preservation rule 'output.return-no-more' says the capability may 'return only what the current output schema allows'. So returning a phone number means adding a new output field (e.g. /phone, perhaps with a crm/Phone concept) to the contract, either in customers.lookup@1 or in a new version such as customers.lookup@2. Changing the handler alone can't do it. The contract also declares no verification methods (evidence.methods is empty, establishable: false), so even an allowed change could not be checked against declared verification. Suggested next step: the contract owner adds an optional phone output (or publishes a new version) and declares a way to verify it. Then the handler in src/handlers/customers.lookup.mjs can be updated to fill it from src/legacy/crm.mjs. Dependents to consider: billing.contact@1 (observes, required) and customers.register@1 (verified-by)."}
=== END ACTION ===
